QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_1

question.text: Himalaya Arbitrage Fund (open-ended Cat III) ended its Q2 on 30-September. By which date must the Investment Manager submit the quarterly activity report to SEBI on the Intermediary Portal, as per Regulation 28 / SEBI circular?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI mandates that every AIF file its quarterly activity report within 10 CALENDAR days from the end of each quarter. For Q2 ending 30-September, the T+10 deadline falls on 10-October. All Cat III AIFs must additionally file a separate leverage report through the SEBI Intermediary Portal. The Trap: 07-Oct is a T+7 invention. 30-Oct is the 30-day CTR-style window. 29-Nov (60 days) is the window for the quarterly investor report on risks/portfolio (not the SEBI filing). Mixing the SEBI T+10 with the investor T+60 is the classic trap. Note: The workbook fixes the 10-calendar-day SEBI deadline and the separate Cat III leverage report; specific operations-calendar workflows are not part of the syllabus.
